name: Shokushu Kangoku ~Maid o Musaboru Nikuyoku no Katamari~
original_name: 触手姦獄～メイドを貪る肉欲の塊～
source:
There is an old house, in which many maids work. Mary starts to work there as a maid, but there is a rumor.... "Cries of girls come out of the house at night, and the girls who once enter the house never come back...." Mary still doesn't know what will happen to her...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090506105849/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006866]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
有一栋老宅，里面有许多女仆在工作。玛丽开始在那里担任女仆，但有一个传言……“夜里会传出女孩的哭声，一旦进入那栋房子的女孩就再也没有回来过……”玛丽还不知道自己将会遭遇什么……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090506105849/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006866]Eroge Shop[/url]]
